title: The Hunt
description:
Deal 10 damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], gain an additional card reward.
upgraded_description:
Deal 15 damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], gain an additional card reward.
notes: When this card deals fatal damage to an enemy, it grants an extra card reward at the end of combat and applies the TheHuntPower (a counter) to track the number of successful kills.
